name: Disappointed Parent
description: Not mad. Just disappointed. Wear a jacket.

storm.head: Stay inside. I mean it.
storm.sub: And unplug the computer. Yes, I know you have stuff to do.

storm.head: Don't you dare go out in that.
storm.sub: Lightning doesn't care how busy you are.

storm.head: Get away from the window.
storm.sub: I don't care if it's 'cool.' It's lightning.

storm.head: Did you charge your phone?
storm.sub: Storms knock the power out. Then you'll be calling me from a dead phone.

storm.head: No baths during lightning.
storm.sub: I read that somewhere. Just humor me.

storm.head: Bring the dog inside.
storm.sub: And the cushions. And yourself. Now, please.

storm.head: Stay off the phone during lightning.
storm.sub: The landline thing. Yes, I know nobody has one. Still.

storm.head: Fill a pot with water.
storm.sub: In case the power goes. Why? Just in case. Trust me.

snow.head: Wear a hat or I swear to God.
snow.sub: And real boots. Not those sneakers with the holes in them.

snow.head: Text me when you get there.
snow.sub: It's snowing. Drive slow. I'm not sleeping until you text me.

snow.head: Scrape your whole windshield.
snow.sub: Not just a little hole. The WHOLE thing. People die that way.

snow.head: Your feet will be wet in those.
snow.sub: Real boots. I know you have them, I bought them.

snow.head: Leave early. There's snow.
snow.sub: Everyone drives like idiots in it. Don't be one of them.

snow.head: Wear the ugly hat.
snow.sub: The one Grandma knitted. It's warm and she'll ask.

snow.head: Is there a shovel in your car?
snow.sub: There should be. And a blanket. And snacks. Do I have to do everything?

snow.head: Wear your gloves this time.
snow.sub: Not in your pocket. On your hands.

rain.head: Take an umbrella. Now.
rain.sub: No, I don't care that it 'ruins the look.' Wet looks worse.

rain.head: Don't come home soaked again.
rain.sub: {pop}% chance of rain. I'm not doing your laundry this time.

rain.head: Where's your raincoat?
rain.sub: Don't tell me you lost another one.

rain.head: Take your shoes off at the door.
rain.sub: I just cleaned. {pop}% chance of mud on my floors.

rain.head: Don't drive through puddles.
rain.sub: You don't know how deep they are. Nobody does.

rain.head: Bring an extra pair of socks.
rain.sub: You'll thank me. You won't actually thank me, but you should.

rain.head: Close the car windows.
rain.sub: You left them open last time. I'm not mad. I'm just remembering.

rain.head: Hang your coat up to dry.
rain.sub: Not on the floor. On a hook. That's what hooks are for.

drizzle.head: It's drizzling. Hood up.
drizzle.sub: Your hair does not look good wet. I say this with love.

drizzle.head: Hood up, sweetheart.
drizzle.sub: You'll catch a cold. Yes, I know that's not how colds work.

drizzle.head: You'll get sick going out wet.
drizzle.sub: Science says otherwise. I say wear a hood.

drizzle.head: Bring the umbrella anyway.
drizzle.sub: You'll thank me later. Probably not. But you should.

drizzle.head: Your glasses are wet, honey.
drizzle.sub: Wipe them. Gently. Not with your shirt.

fog.head: Headlights on, sweetie.
fog.sub: It's foggy as hell. And put the damn phone down while driving.

fog.head: Drive slower than you think.
fog.sub: Slower. Slower than that. I mean it.

fog.head: Text me when you get there.
fog.sub: It's foggy. I'll be up. I won't sleep.

fog.head: Low beams, not brights.
fog.sub: Your father did that once and we ended up in a ditch.

fog.head: Don't tailgate in this.
fog.sub: Leave room. More room. I'm serious.

fog.head: Wear something bright.
fog.sub: So cars can see you. Is that so much to ask?

windy.head: Tie your hair back.
windy.sub: Gusts to {gusts}. And bring the patio chairs in, I asked you twice.

windy.head: Hold onto your hat.
windy.sub: That's how you lost the last one. And the one before that.

windy.head: Don't park under the tree.
windy.sub: Gusts to {gusts}. Branches fall. I've seen it.

windy.head: Close the windows.
windy.sub: All of them. Do you want leaves in your bed?

windy.head: Bring the patio chairs in.
windy.sub: I asked you yesterday. Gusts to {gusts}. Today, please.

windy.head: Don't fling the car door open.
windy.sub: The wind will rip it off. I've seen it happen. Twice.

scorching.head: Drink some water. WATER.
scorching.sub: Not that energy drink crap. {temp} out there.

scorching.head: Sunscreen. Did you put on sunscreen?
scorching.sub: I can tell you didn't. Go back inside and do it.

scorching.head: Don't leave anything in the car.
scorching.sub: Not the dog, not the groceries, not your lip balm. {temp} out.

scorching.head: Stay out of the sun, it's {temp}.
scorching.sub: And reapply sunscreen. Every two hours. I'll set a reminder.

scorching.head: Wear a hat. A real one.
scorching.sub: Not a backwards cap. Your neck burns too.

scorching.head: Are you peeing clear?
scorching.sub: Don't make that face. It's {feels}. It's a valid question.

scorching.head: Stay in the shade, please.
scorching.sub: It's {temp}. I worry. That's my job.

scorching.head: Don't touch the slide.
scorching.sub: Or the car door. Or the seatbelt. Everything is hot.

hot.head: Did you drink water today?
hot.sub: {temp}. Your body is 60% water and you're acting like it's 6%.

hot.head: Sunscreen. Even if it's cloudy.
hot.sub: UV is {uv}. You'll burn and then you'll complain.

hot.head: Don't wear jeans in this.
hot.sub: It's {temp}. You'll be miserable. You know I'm right.

hot.head: Bring a water bottle.
hot.sub: Not a soda. A water bottle. With water in it.

hot.head: Wear the sunscreen I bought you.
hot.sub: It's in the bathroom. Behind the other sunscreen.

hot.head: Drink more water than you think.
You look flushed.
hot.sub: Sit down. Drink water. Don't argue.

freezing.head: Where is your coat?
freezing.sub: Feels like {feels}. You will catch your death. Don't argue.

freezing.head: Put on a damn jacket. I'm not asking.
freezing.sub: And gloves. I bought you gloves. Where are the gloves?

freezing.head: Did you warm up the car?
freezing.sub: Let it run a minute. It's {temp}. Engines have feelings too.

freezing.head: Cover your ears.
freezing.sub: You'll get frostbite and then you'll be the kid with no ears.

freezing.head: Two pairs of socks.
freezing.sub: It's {feels}. Two. Pairs. Don't argue with me.

freezing.head: Drip the faucets tonight.
freezing.sub: Low of {low}. Frozen pipes cost more than your rent.

freezing.head: Keep a blanket in your car.
freezing.sub: If you get stuck, you'll thank me. It's {temp}.

cold.head: Bring a sweater.
cold.sub: You always say you're fine and then you're cold. {temp} out there.

cold.head: You're going out like THAT?
cold.sub: High of {high}. Go put on a real jacket.

cold.head: Zip up your jacket.
cold.sub: It's not a cape. Zip it.

cold.head: Wear a scarf, please.
cold.sub: For me. Do it for me.

cold.head: You'll catch your death.
cold.sub: I know that's not a real thing. Wear the jacket anyway.

cold.head: Your hands are freezing.
cold.sub: Where are your gloves? Did you lose them? Again?

cold.head: You need a warmer coat.
cold.sub: That's a fashion jacket. That's not a coat.

nice.head: Go outside. Get some sun.
nice.sub: It's lovely out. You look pale, honey.

nice.head: Why are you inside?
nice.sub: {temp} and beautiful. Go touch grass, I'm serious.

nice.head: Open the windows, it's lovely.
nice.sub: Let some fresh air in. Your room smells like a teenager.

nice.head: Call your grandmother.
nice.sub: Then go for a walk. It's {temp} and beautiful.

nice.head: Look at that sky!
nice.sub: I took a picture. I'll send it to you. I sent it to you.

nice.head: Get off the computer.
nice.sub: It's a gorgeous day. When I was your age we were outside all day.

nice.head: Go for a walk with a friend.
nice.sub: It's {temp}. Real people. Not on the phone.

nice.head: Hang the laundry outside.
nice.sub: It's a beautiful drying day. Your grandmother would be thrilled.

meh.head: It's fine. Bring a jacket anyway.
meh.sub: You never know. I'm just saying.

meh.head: Kinda gray. Call your grandmother.
meh.sub: Perfect day for it. She asks about you.

meh.head: Bring a light jacket, just in case.
meh.sub: In case of what? In case of weather. Just bring it.

meh.head: Good day to clean your room.
Eat something green today.
meh.sub: It's {temp} and gray. A vegetable won't fix it but it won't hurt.

meh.head: Get some vitamin D.
meh.sub: From a pill, since the sun isn't helping.

meh.head: Are you eating okay?
meh.sub: You sound tired. It's gray out. Eat something warm.

clearNight.head: Why are you still up?
clearNight.sub: It's late. The weather will still be there tomorrow. Go to bed.

clearNight.head: Lock the door.
clearNight.sub: And check it again. I worry.

clearNight.head: It's late. Put the phone down.
clearNight.sub: The weather will still be there in the morning. So will I.

clearNight.head: Did you eat dinner?
clearNight.sub: Cereal doesn't count. Clear skies, {temp}. Go to bed.

clearNight.head: Look at the stars, then sleep.
clearNight.sub: Clear skies tonight. Five minutes of stars, then bed.

clearNight.head: Leave the porch light on.
clearNight.sub: For whoever's coming home late. It's {temp} out.

clearNight.head: Text me goodnight.
clearNight.sub: It's clear and {temp}. I just like knowing you're home.
